title: Kuṇḍalinī ascent · bhāvana-led (Sivananda)
provenance: Sivananda: feel Kundalini rise chakra-to-chakra on inhalation; bhāvana over ratio. Simplified score.

events.iast: Sit at the base triangle · feel, don't force

events.cue: Inhale — feel her stir at the base.
Through throat and brow to the crown.
She reaches the thousand-petalled. Rest in the shower.
Descend gently to the heart. Rest.
